# Streak Tracker Project - Workspace Instructions

This is a modern habit tracking web application with 3D animations and gamification.

## Tech Stack
- Next.js 14+ with App Router
- TypeScript
- Tailwind CSS
- React Three Fiber (Three.js)
- Framer Motion
- shadcn/ui components

## Project Status
- [x] Project structure created
- [x] Dependencies configured
- [x] Core components built
- [x] 3D animations implemented
- [x] Gamification features added
